bagPolicy.summary: The stadium guide permits clear bags up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches; medical bags receive additional inspection at Gates 6 and 10. The university’s published clear-bag rule covers sporting events, so confirm requirements for a concert.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: For football games, reserved priority parking is controlled by digital permits from the Athletic Association. Fans without reserved parking who need assistance can park in the East Campus Parking Deck and take the free fan shuttle to Gate 6. Game day parking hotline: 706-425-3052.

rideshare.summary: The stadium A-Z guide says there is no designated rideshare pickup area.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Alcohol is sold at various stadium concession stands for university events. Concert menus and hours may differ.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The stadium guide lists wheelchair seating in the upper West Endzone plaza and Sections 114, 126, 136 and the 600 Level. Medical bag screening is at Gates 6 and 10.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The stadium A-Z guide states that re-entry is not allowed.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The football A-Z guide lists will call at the East End ticket window on East Campus Road; concert pickup instructions should be checked for the specific show.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: For football games, all gates open two hours before kickoff. Students enter through the Student Ticket gates at Gate 1, Gate 3, and Gate 4A. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.
